item.title: Transmission Issues [ URGENT ]
item.description: Rode the ZX-10R for the first time with transmission issues. The transmission would not change after third gear -- I'm able to change from N to 3, so the next day I've rode it back to the dealership for investigation.

item.title: Engine Rebuild In Progress
item.description: ZX-10R has been transported to the dealership due to early signs of engine seizure. Engine Rebuild imminent.

item.title: Engine Rebuild Completed
item.description: ZX-10R Engine rebuild has been completed at Team Charlotte Motorsports and has been transported via trailer.

item.title: Engine Service: Valve Replacement
item.description: ZX-10R has been transported to the dealership for engine valve replacement. Currently waiting for head gasket since all parts have been ordered & delivered under warranty.

item.title: Engine Service: Valve Replacement in Progress
item.description: I've spoke to my service manager at Team Charlotte Motorsports and was told that the mechanic will be replacing the valves on the ZX-10R today. All parts have been delivered under warranty from Kawasaki. At the time of writing, the ZX-10R has been dormant at the dealership since May 8 (3 months ago).

item.title: Engine Service: Lee's Performance
item.description: The motor was sent from Team Charlotte Motorsports to Lee's Performance for machining. The dealership ordered more parts and they have been sent for Lee to work on. The technician notified me about the motor being completed today and has been transported back to the dealership and will start mounting the motor back onto the bike.
